urumqi-2017.notes: Source 2 holds 94 team rows; source 3 has 96. The PDFs in source 1 give on-site dates of 14-15 October 2017 (the registration guide puts the contest on 15 October), which differ from the catalogue date 2017-12-03; the scoreboard page's clock reads 12/5/2017.

sources.evidence: Crawl of the Xinjiang University Online Judge site, which carries PDF notices of the 42nd ACM-ICPC Asia regional contest at Urumqi (dated 2017-09-12 for the slot-application notice).
